business_rules.verb_concept: record abnormal paragraph identifier for report open failure

business_rules.natural_language_rule: If not WS report good (WS-Report-Good), then the abnormal paragraph (Abn-Paragraph) is set to "1010".

business_rules.verb_concept: set line count for page headings
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The line count (LineCount) is set to 3.

business_rules.verb_concept: increment page count when printing page headings
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The page count (PageCount) is increased by 1.

business_rules.verb_concept: record abnormal paragraph identifier for member file read failure
business_rules.rule: If (TRUE), then Abn-Paragraph is set to "5000".
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The abnormal paragraph identifier is always set to "5000".

business_rules.verb_concept: record abnormal status code for member file read failure
business_rules.rule: If (TRUE), then Abn-Code is set to WS-Member-Status.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The abnormal code is always set to the member-file status.

business_rules.verb_concept: set printed page number when a new page is required
business_rules.rule: If (LineCount is at least 40 AND LineCount is at most 99), then PrnPageNum is set to PageCount.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If the line count (LineCount) is between 40 and 99 (inclusive), then the printed page number (PrnPageNum) is set to the page count (PageCount).

business_rules.verb_concept: reset line count for a new page when a new page is required
business_rules.rule: If (LineCount is at least 40 AND LineCount is at most 99), then LineCount is set to 3.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If the line count (LineCount) is between 40 and 99 (inclusive), then the line count is set to 3.

business_rules.verb_concept: increment page count for a new page when a new page is required
business_rules.rule: If (LineCount is at least 40 AND LineCount is at most 99), then PageCount is increased by 1.
business_rules.natural_language_rule: If the line count (LineCount) is between 40 and 99 (inclusive), then the page count (PageCount) is increased by 1.

business_rules.verb_concept: set printed member identifier for report detail
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The printed member identifier (PrnMemberId) is set to the member identifier (MemberId).

business_rules.verb_concept: set printed member name for report detail
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The printed member name (PrnMemberName) is set to the member name (MemberName).

business_rules.verb_concept: set printed member type for report detail
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The printed member type (PrnMemberType) is set to the member type (MemberType).

business_rules.verb_concept: set printed member gender for report detail
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The printed member gender (PrnMemberGender) is set to the member gender (MemberGender).

business_rules.verb_concept: increment line count after printing a member detail line
business_rules.natural_language_rule: The line count (LineCount) is increased by 1.
